title: dispatch-gates: a new ui/packages/*/scripts/*.mjs does not derive the ui/scripts suite gate
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Found by zone a4-S while building #37223 (PR #37230). It was reported to seat repo:objectstack#4 as out of scope, and the seat files it here.

## What

The dev added a new script under `ui/packages/*/scripts/`. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` printed no `ui/scripts` suite gate for that file. CI `Test UI` then went red on exactly `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-ui-root-lookups.test.ts`.

## Why, read at main

- The `ui-scripts-suite-input` row in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` matches through `UI_SCRIPTS_SUITE_ROOTS`.
- Those roots are `ui/packages/**/src`, `ui/packages/**/src/**`, `ui/apps/**`, `skills/objectui/**` and `ui/scripts/**`.
- `ui/packages/*/scripts/**` is not among them.
- Yet `ui/scripts/check-ui-root-lookups.mjs` scans the whole ui tree, and its test runs in that suite. Today `ui/packages/components/scripts/` and `ui/packages/fields/scripts/` exist.

Re-check: `grep -n -A7 'UI_SCRIPTS_SUITE_ROOTS *=' scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs`

## Done when

A path under `ui/packages/*/scripts/` makes `dispatch-gates --commands` print the `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` gate. Either widen the roots to every ui file the suite reads, or derive them from what the suite reads. A self-test case pins it.

## Notes

- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` and its data module are guard instruments: Tier H.
- Size XS.
